newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-BALTA INSURANCE EYES LATVA CONTROLLING STAKE.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-BALTA INSURANCE EYES LATVA CONTROLLING STAKE.

text.p: The Balta insurance company said on Tuesday that it plans to participate in the sell-off of the state-run Latva insurance firm.
"We plan to participate in the privatisation of Latva," Janis Sprincis, Balta's vice-president, told Reuters.
"Balta will definitely have its own savings insurance unit, be that Latva or otherwise," Sprincis said.
Balta and Latva were formed in 1992 by splitting the former local branch of the then all-union insurance company Gosstrah.
Balta took over the risk insurance part, forming a joint-venture with Denmark's Baltica insurance company among other partners.
The state-run Latva, Rigas komercbanka and Riga municipality were also among the Balta joint-venture founders.
The newspaper Diena reported on Tuesday that the privatisation of Latva was being launched and that it would be sold before the end of the year.
